Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a leading chemical company located in the heart of New York City at 363 East 42nd Street, NY, NY 10017. With a strong emphasis on innovation and quality, Standardpharm has established itself as a trusted provider of chemical products and solutions to a wide range of industries.

Since its inception, Standardpharm has been committed to meeting the diverse needs of its customers by offering a comprehensive portfolio of high-quality chemicals and cutting-edge technologies. Our team of experienced chemists and researchers work tirelessly to develop new and improved products that meet the ever-evolving demands of the market.

At Standardpharm, we prioritize safety, sustainability, and customer satisfaction in everything we do. We adhere to strict quality control standards to ensure that our products meet the highest industry regulations and standards. Our state-of-the-art facilities are equipped with the latest technology to guarantee the consistency and reliability of our products.

As a customer-centric company, we strive to build long-term partnerships with our clients by providing exceptional service and support. Whether you are a small business or a multinational corporation, we tailor our solutions to meet your specific requirements and exceed your expectations.

In a rapidly changing global economy, Standardpharm is dedicated to staying ahead of the curve and setting new standards in the chemical industry. We are committed to continuous improvement, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. Contact us today to learn more about how Standardpharm can meet your chemical needs.
